method.binary_metrics: Newcombe hybrid score interval using Wilson limits for two proportions, computed from committed aggregate counts.
method.paired_design_note: The two conditions use the same benchmark items, but paired discordance counts are not committed. These aggregate-only intervals therefore treat the two condition proportions as independent and are not substitutes for preferred paired intervals.
method.eq_bench_note: EQ-Bench is a continuous score, so a binomial interval is not appropriate. A valid interval would require per-item score dispersion or the raw paired item scores, which are not committed.

eq_bench.reason: Continuous score; binomial CI is not applicable and committed aggregates do not contain per-item variance.

aggregate_relative_reduction.interpretation: Descriptive aggregate only. It combines heterogeneous metrics, and a defensible combined interval cannot be reconstructed from committed aggregates without paired/per-item covariance information.
